Estimated baseline function

Source: R/methods.R
baseline.Rd

Estimated baseline function

Usage

baseline(object, ...)

# S3 method for class 'pcdfit'
baseline(object, ...)

Arguments

object

A fitted pcdreg() model.

...

Ignored.

Value

A tibble with one row per examination time on the pooled grid. For pcdreg() it gives the jump sizes and the cumulative baseline rate \(\Lambda(t)\); for pcdreg() it gives the baseline mean \(\mu(t)\), which is not constrained to increase.

Examples

set.seed(1)
d <- sim_pcd(80, beta = c(1, -1), lambda = function(t) 8 / (1 + t))
head(baseline(pcdreg(pcd(id, tstart, tstop, count) ~ x1 + x2, d)))
#> # A tibble: 6 × 3
#>    time     jump cumrate
#>   <dbl>    <dbl>   <dbl>
#> 1  0.01 1.03e- 1   0.103
#> 2  0.02 1.60e-81   0.103
#> 3  0.03 4.92e-81   0.103
#> 4  0.04 0          0.103
#> 5  0.05 0          0.103
#> 6  0.06 0          0.103
head(baseline(pcdreg(pcd(id, tstart, tstop, count) ~ x1 + x2, d, model = "mean")))
#> # A tibble: 6 × 2
#>    time  mean
#>   <dbl> <dbl>
#> 1  0.01 0.291
#> 2  0.02 0    
#> 3  0.03 0    
#> 4  0.04 0    
#> 5  0.05 0    
#> 6  0.06 0
